name: Glimmer Storefront Agent (fictional)

one_liner.value: Glimmer Storefront Agent writes product descriptions for online stores.

notes: Invented site. The homepage is a JavaScript shell: the HTML holds a title, a meta description and scripts. Everything else about the product (integrations, a price, a multi-agent claim, a headquarters) exists only inside the script, so without rendering the site states nothing more and every other field is unknown.
